premises.text: Development environments often do not match production environments, leading to wasted time chasing bugs.
premises.evidence_span: our development environments never matched up with our production environments.

premises.text: Long testing times result in engineers being unproductive while they wait.
premises.evidence_span: Testing took forever. And when your tests take a long time to run, your engineers essentially are not doing work.

premises.text: Build breaks block the entire team from working, causing frustration.
premises.evidence_span: when a build break happens, your entire team is blocked from doing work, and your engineers end up raging.

premises.text: Quality can make development teams more effective by preventing build breaks and reducing testing times.
premises.evidence_span: quality can make your development team 20% more effective.

premises.text: Quality allows changes to be tested in an isolated environment, preventing disruptions to the team.
premises.evidence_span: quality has just picked up the change. And what it actually does at this point is it takes that change and holds it in a limbo state.

premises.text: The market for software testing solutions is large, with millions of engineers worldwide.
premises.evidence_span: there's 20 million engineers worldwide. It's one of the fastest-growing occupations in the world.

value.text: Engineers can work more effectively and happily with the right software testing tools.
value.evidence_span: if you make us happier, or if you make us more effective, you make us much, much happier.
